problem: Calculate the circulation $Γ$ of the vector field $F(x,y)=\frac{5}{y}\,i-\frac{5}{x}\,j$ along the closed curve $C$ given by $r(t)=\operatorname{sin}⁡t\,i+\operatorname{cos}⁡t\,j$ for $t\in [0,2\pi ).$ Interpret circulation as the sum of the four convergent improper line integrals over the open quadrant arcs, taking independent one-sided limits at $(0,\pm1)$ and $(\pm1,0)$. Equivalently, integrate the continuous extension of the scalar pullback $F(r(t))\cdot r\prime(t)$. The field itself remains undefined at the four axis intersections, so the original ordinary circulation is undefined.
